```{r setup}
library(nepstest)
```

This package helps with testing neps sc6 field data. It contains a few functions specifically designed to test different tags in the programming instruction sheets (PVs: Programmiervorlagen).

The Work task "NEPS Felddatenprüfung" mostly involves testing filter ways through the questionaire (af-tags), auto codes of variables (ac-tags) and value range restrictions (ra-tags). Testing variable names (va-tag), variable labels (vb-tag) and value codes and labels (we-tag) is also part of this work process but was automated with the shiny app "NEPS_Labelprüfung_app".
